license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: MDS Denominator File
description: Beneficiary-year file representing individuals observed in the Minimum Data Set. Records contain one row per beneficiary per calendar year and include demographic fields used for cohort construction and linkage.

content.bene_id: String: Encrypted beneficiary identifier used to uniquely identify residents across MDS records.
content.year: Int64: Calendar year corresponding to the beneficiary-year observation in MDS.
content.birth_date: Date32[day]: Beneficiary date of birth derived from MDS records.
content.age: Int64: Beneficiary age in years, calculated as calendar year minus year of birth.
content.sex: String: Beneficiary sex derived from MDS records. Values: '1' = Male, '2' = Female, '0' = Unknown or conflicting values.
content.race: Int64: Beneficiary race category derived from MDS race indicators. Values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = White, 2 = African American/Black, 3 = Hispanic, 4 = Asian, 5 = American Indian or Alaska Native, 6 = Native Hawaiian or Pacific Islander, 7 = Multiple races reported.
